evidence_quotes.two_concerns_question: I just wanted to let you know that we talked to a lot of people everyday and most of them have one or two concerns either the are not showing up on time or damage to their items are either of those a concern for you.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer raised no concerns — said she looked at ratings, saw the $2,000 damage coverage, packed valuables already, and felt confident. N/A applies.
evidence_quotes.value_days: I just wanted to let you know that in case if you are also flexible, our best validates is every Tuesdays Wednesdays and Thursdays where in the rate is cheaper compared to Saturday and Friday. It is only $95 per hour per member. If you move it on a weekday.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_then_ask: Rep never asked for the business — customer said she was only getting a rough estimate and would call back once paperwork was finalized. Rep offered to send email quote and said 'just feel free to give us a call at anytime' but made no explicit ask for the move or any booking commitment.

top_strength: Rep gathered all logistics details methodically, asked the two-concerns question correctly, and delivered a specific anchored estimate ($900 for 3.5–4.5 hours with two movers) that was personalized to the customer's move profile and floor conditions.
coaching_note: Rep must ask an explicit version of 'Would you like our help with your move?' before accepting 'I'll call back later' — the step 7 ask is non-optional even if the customer ends up not booking on that call; without it, there is no close attempt at all.
